_README: Pre-fills the GUI 2D-Scan panel. Q1 axis -> LTB:Q1_1, Q2 axis -> LTB:Q1_2.
Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored by the loader.
PV names below are CONFIRMED from the ALS MML (buildmmlcaen_als.m, Caen SY3634):
Values are in HARDWARE units = AMPS. MML full-scale Setpoint.Range = +/-10 A,
default Setpoint.Tolerance = 0.1 A. These supplies ramp internally (see
<base>:Ramping / <base>:SlewRate), so a single absolute write slews there.
STILL TODO before running: set the real scan range (min/max/points) and the
HARD safe band (limit_min/limit_max) for THIS study. limit_min/limit_max =
the band outside which every write is refused; min/max/points = the sweep,
and must sit inside it: limit_min <= min <= max <= limit_max.
The +/-10 limits below are the MML full-scale as a STARTING point -- narrow
them to the safe band you actually want for the measurement.
